services.name: Sauna Brunch
services.desc: Join us for a sauna and optional cold plunge at Tuli followed by brunch at Seven Acre. Brunch includes one entrée, a drink, and live jazz music. All for $40/person. Spots are limited, so book now through Seven Acre’s website -

services.name: Botanical Aufguss
services.desc: Join us for a guided ritual at Tuli Sauna & Plunge July 30th at 5 or 6:30PM. Limited to just five guests per session, this intimate experience is provided by Flora & Sauna - a botanical sauna ritual guide that blends together seasonal plants, steam, breath, tea, body care, and sacred hospitality. Aufguss: Experience a traditional sauna ritual where botanicals and rhythmic airflow elevate both the heat and your senses. Guided Breathwork: Support your nervous system through intentional breath awareness and gentle guidance during your sauna cycles.
